subject: Prepaid capacity release: annual retainer cadence & operational checkpoints
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightbay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Prepaid capacity release: annual retainer cadence & operational checkpoints

Hi Elena —

Nice to meet you over email. Attached is a proposed schedule for BrightBay's annual prepaid retainer and a short ops checklist so we can align on invoicing, VAT treatment, and drawdown triggers. High-level asks: 

- Confirm preferred invoicing frequency (monthly/quarterly) and if you require net-of-VAT invoices on our side.
- Confirm bank remit details and PO number format you need on invoices.
- Confirm whether BrightBay wants monthly drawdowns executed automatically by threshold (e.g., when consumption reaches 80% of the monthly budget) or via manual approval.

What we're proposing (see AnnualPrepaySchedule.xlsx):
1) Issue monthly invoices on the 1st for the previous month's reserved capacity (net-of-VAT where requested).
2) Maintain an internal drawdown ledger; trigger automatic top-ups when remaining prepaid balance < 15% of committed monthly usage.
3) Provide SOC2 evidence (SOC2-proof.pdf) and a short drawdown-runbook for procurement.

Can you confirm by early next week? If helpful we can put together a short runbook meeting — I copied Priyom (billing ops) and Kimberly (tax lead).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Enterprise Billing | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attach: AnnualPrepaySchedule.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-proof.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightbay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Prepaid capacity release: annual retainer cadence & operational checkpoints

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the schedule. BrightBay prefers monthly invoicing and would like invoices generated net-of-VAT with VAT shown separately for reconciliation. Our procurement team also needs the PO number on the invoice (format: BB-PO-YYYY-####).

Automatic drawdowns sound fine provided we get notification 48 hours before a top-up; for budget governance we still require a monthly statement and a single approver on any drawdown > €50k.

I also need a copy of your standard remit instructions for SEPA transfers and the contact for tax evidence (to confirm VAT reverse-charge or local VAT treatment).

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement | BrightBay
elena.rossi@brightbay.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightbay.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prepaid capacity release: annual retainer cadence & operational checkpoints

Thanks Marissa / Elena —

Quick internal note on ops design and next steps (draft):

1) Invoicing cadence: issue monthly invoices on the 1st for prior month usage. Invoice format will include: invoice date, net amount, VAT line, PO field (BB-PO-YYYY-####). We'll add a "PO" metadata field in the invoice PDF so your AP system can auto-match.

2) Drawdown triggers: implement automatic drawdown when prepaid balance <= 15% of monthly committed spend. Send pre-top-up notification 48 hours in advance to finance@brightbay.com and cc the procurement approver. For any single drawdown > €50k require opt-in approval within a 24-hour window.

3) VAT handling: Kimberly will prepare a short VAT memo indicating when we issue net-of-VAT vs gross invoice (reverse-charge vs local VAT). She'll include sample invoice PDFs for SEPA wire routing and a copy of our KYC remit instructions.

4) Technical handoffs: we'll add a short webhook to your billing webhook endpoint that emits balance and upcoming drawdown events (payload includes contract_id and remaining_balance). We can scope this as a small engineering task — estimated 2 days.

Attachments: drawdown-runbook.md (ops steps and API webhook examples)

Action items:
- Kimberly: draft VAT memo + sample invoices by EOD Mon (Apr 26).
- Marissa: send final AnnualPrepaySchedule.xlsx with monthly amounts and PO mapping.
- Priyom: draft webhook spec and runbook (attached).

-Priyom
Priyom Das
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightbay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Prepaid capacity release: annual retainer cadence & operational checkpoints

All —

Thanks for the quick alignment. Confirming the plan and next steps: 

- Monthly invoices on the 1st, net-of-VAT view with VAT line displayed. We'll include the PO (BB-PO-YYYY-####) in a discrete invoice metadata field for BrightBay AP.
- Automatic drawdowns at <=15% remaining, 48-hour notice, manual approval required for >€50k.
- Kimberly will send VAT memo and sample invoice templates by EOD Mon.
- Priyom will post the webhook spec to the runbook and we'll loop in Eng for a 2-day turn.

I've scheduled a 30m kickoff to walk through the runbook and the HubSpot contract record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BRB-2024-09 — calendar invite (Kickoff: BrightBay prepay ops) is live here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=kickoff-brightbay-prepay

If there are no objections I'll upload the finalized AnnualPrepaySchedule.xlsx and drawdown-runbook.md to the shared billing folder and trigger invoice template generation next week.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Enterprise Billing | Redwood Inference
